summary: The Eastern Shore of Virginia Public Library System relies on E-Rate funding for essential services and community access. Losing funding would result in significant costs and service disruptions for the library system and the community.

claims.argument: Continuing E-Rate for the Eastern Shore of Virginia Public Library System will ensue:
claims.evidence_quote:
1) Reduction of other library services and programs the community has come to rely
2) Increased burden for library funding from local governments to provide internet service, licenses, and maintain and upgrade equipment at the cost of $30,000 - $50,000/year
3) Loss of access to vital services including: homework assistance, job applications, telehealth, classes, databases, eBooks, streaming services, and veteran’s assistance
4) Delay in equipment maintenance and upgrades – modems, routers, switches, and access points all have finite lifecycles and must be regularly maintained and replaced
